mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS productImage, p.price AS price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, c.quantity AS quantity, c.checked AS checked, p.stock AS stock, p.status AS productStatus, (p.price * c.quantity) AS subtotal FROM cart c INNER JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
